content: Go ACP SDK: github.com/coder/acp-go-sdk v0.20.0 (Nov 18 2026) is the de facto Go SDK: Apache-2.0, stdlib-only (go 1.21), both Agent and Client sides (acp.Agent + NewAgentSideConnection / NewClientSideConnection), wire types generated from official ACP schema (v0.18+ targets schema 1.32.0), JSON-RPC 2.0 newline-framed over stdio built in, optional method interfaces answer -32601, extension methods supported. Actively maintained by Coder (ThomasK33), 7 Go community libs exist total; coder's is the most used (15 imports/18 importers on pkg.go.dev).
